training_policy: Per receiver and method, fit one UTC-linear line to window estimates from visits 5 and 8 only.
held_policy: Evaluate each frozen prediction on the identical held even-Qin pilot matrices from visits 11 and 12; held estimates and profile optima never influence predictions.
held_objective: Mean ordinary profiled coherence of held even-Qin frames at the method prediction; common waveform objective, larger is better.
window_estimate: Median absolute CFO across complete frames; each frame uses the named estimator in its fixed acquisition basin.
